title: DATETIMEOFFSET Data Type
description: Learn how to use the DATETIMEOFFSET data type to store datetime values with time zone offsets.

data.text: The DATETIMEOFFSET data type stores a datetime value along with a time zone offset. This makes it ideal for applications that need to track times across different time zones.

data.title: DATETIMEOFFSET Syntax
data.content: Defines a DATETIMEOFFSET column with optional fractional seconds precision.

data.text: The time zone offset ranges from -14:00 to +14:00 and is represented as [+|−] hh:mm.

data.title: Create DATETIMEOFFSET Column
data.content: Creates a table with a DATETIMEOFFSET column.

data.title: Insert DATETIMEOFFSET Value
data.content: Inserts a row with a DATETIMEOFFSET value including time zone offset.

data.title: Convert Time Zones
data.content: Converts DATETIMEOFFSET values to different time zones.
data.code:
SELECT 
    id, 
    message, 
    created_at 
        AS 'Pacific Standard Time',
    created_at AT TIME ZONE 'SE Asia Standard Time' 
        AS 'SE Asia Standard Time'
FROM 
    messages;

data.title: DATETIMEOFFSET Key Points
points: DATETIMEOFFSET stores datetime with a time zone offset.
Time zone offset ranges from -14:00 to +14:00.
Use AT TIME ZONE to convert between time zones.
Ideal for applications tracking times across multiple regions.
Fractional seconds precision ranges from 0 to 7.
